GenAiPlugin.description: Plan, run, and complete sprints. Add or remove cards from sprints.
GenAiPlugin.scope: Use this topic when the user wants to manage sprints. This includes creating new sprints, starting or completing sprints, adding cards to a sprint, removing cards from a sprint, checking sprint status and progress, or viewing the backlog. Also use this when the user asks about sprint goals, dates, or how many points are completed.
